cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your plate's back in the cupboard, ready for Sunday lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That one's got flowers. Ours were plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll take that one. The potatoes will cover the flowers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not hiding it under potatoes. I want six matching plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get five more before lunch. Keep the plain ones for spares; there's no need to count those today.

mechanism: A authorizes a replacement table setting and limits inspection so a plate can be restored without explaining the missing or damaged original.
confusable: Generic redecorating would welcome comparison; the Drive needs a restoration with concealed cause and A approval controlling scrutiny.
comparison: A mismatched plate leads to replacement of the set, unlike the umbrella alternative removing visible residue from the same object.
seedUse: Use D37-b floral mismatch, potatoes and six matching plates; S01 permission should shape how B can inspect and request restoration.
